meta.notes: A server command. "name" is the word typed after the slash and "aliases" are other words for it; neither may be a vanilla command. The command runs the event "welcome", which is declared in "events" with the same actions blocks and items use, as the player who typed it. "feedback_text" is the answer in chat (its language key is generated). To run a data pack function instead of an event, name it in "function" and set "permission" to 2 or more. It needs the Fabric mod jar export; the vanilla packs keep only its models, pictures and language keys.
